name: Page to Hand
subtitle: Piano practice from your score
promotionalText: Turn MIDI and MusicXML scores into focused practice with real-keyboard feedback, exact trouble bars, and one clear next step.
description:
Page to Hand turns the score in front of you into a focused piano-practice session. Bring your own music, play it on a real keyboard, and see exactly what deserves another pass.

PRACTICE YOUR OWN MUSIC
• Import MIDI, MusicXML, and MXL scores.
• Work from full notation, falling notes, or both together.
• Slow the tempo, loop difficult bars, and practise either hand.

PLAY ON A REAL PIANO
• Connect a USB or Bluetooth MIDI keyboard for immediate note, timing, hold, and touch feedback.
• Use the on-screen keyboard when your piano is not nearby.
• Choose Learn mode when you want the music to wait, or Perform when you want an honest run at tempo.

KNOW WHAT TO FIX NEXT
• See wrong, early, late, and missed notes directly on the score.
• Review accuracy, timing, holds, and touch without an arcade score.
• Continue with the hardest bars, a cleaner pass, or the next useful task.
• Compare like-for-like attempts and recognize a true personal best.

BUILD THE WHOLE SKILL
• Follow a calm daily plan across sight reading, repertoire, scales, technique, theory, and ear training.
• Practise with more than 2,300 public-domain and openly licensed scores.
• Add focused study packs for Hanon, Czerny, Burgmüller, Clementi, Schumann, and more.
• Memorise a piece as its notation fades bar by bar.

OWN YOUR PRACTICE
Your scores, history, and settings stay on your device. Sync through Page to Hand in iCloud Drive, export a complete backup, and continue without an account. Page to Hand has no ads and no subscription.

A MIDI keyboard is recommended, not required.
